description: Structured eval definitions for the QuickSight Dashboard Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across QuickSight scenarios (Enterprise SPICE dashboard with Athena + RLS, template-based multi-tenant deployment, private RDS via VPC connection, Direct Query on Redshift, VPC connection with Standard edition prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Enterprise SPICE dashboard with Athena data source and RLS
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Enterprise edition, SPICE ingestion from Athena, hourly refresh schedule, row-level security via rules dataset
eval_cases.prompt: Create a QuickSight dashboard in us-east-1 (aws-account-id 123456789012, Enterprise edition). Data source: Athena workgroup primary. Dataset sales_metrics with SPICE mode, hourly refresh. Analysis with 2 sheets. Dashboard sales-dashboard. Enable row-level security using a rules dataset mapping users to region values. Tags: Environment=production, Domain=sales.
eval_cases.expected_output:
QUICKSIGHT_DASHBOARD: sales-dashboard (version 1)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] QuickSight account: my-org-quicksight (edition: Enterprise, region: us-east-1)
  [✓] Data source: ds-athena-prod (type: Athena)
  [✓] Dataset: ds-sales-metrics (mode: SPICE)
  [✓] SPICE refresh schedule: HOURLY
  [✓] Row-level security: ENABLED
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws quicksight describe-dashboard --aws-account-id 123456789012 --dashboard-id sales-dashboard --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Template-based multi-tenant dashboard deployment
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — template creation from analysis, per-tenant datasets and dashboards from template, RLS per tenant, template update propagation
eval_cases.prompt: Create a QuickSight template sales-template from analysis sales-analysis in us-east-1, aws-account-id 123456789012, Enterprise edition. Deploy dashboards for Tenant A and Tenant B from the template, each with its own dataset (ds-tenant-a-sales, ds-tenant-b-sales) and RLS rules per tenant. Tags: Environment=production, Pattern=multi-tenant.
eval_cases.expected_output:
QUICKSIGHT_DASHBOARD: tenant-a-sales (version 1)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Template: sales-template (version: 1)
  [✓] Dataset: ds-tenant-a-sales (mode: SPICE)
  [✓] Row-level security: ENABLED
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws quicksight describe-template --aws-account-id 123456789012 --template-id sales-template --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Private RDS PostgreSQL via VPC connection with SPICE dataset
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Enterprise edition, VPC connection for private RDS, IAM role for ENI management, SPICE dataset with daily refresh
eval_cases.prompt: Create a QuickSight dashboard in us-east-1, aws-account-id 123456789012, Enterprise edition. Data source: private RDS PostgreSQL at prod-db.cluster-abc123.us-east-1.rds.amazonaws.com port 5432, database analytics. VPC connection using subnets subnet-aaa111, subnet-bbb222 and security group sg-quicksight. IAM role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/QuickSightVpcRole. Dataset ops_metrics with SPICE mode, daily refresh. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
QUICKSIGHT_DASHBOARD: ops-dashboard (version 1)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Data source: ds-rds-prod (type: PostgreSQL)
  [✓] VPC connection: vpc-conn-prod (status: AVAILABLE)
  [✓] Dataset: ds-ops-metrics (mode: SPICE)
  [✓] IAM service role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/QuickSightVpcRole
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws quicksight describe-vpc-connection --aws-account-id 123456789012 --vpc-connection-id vpc-conn-prod --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Direct Query dashboard on Redshift for executive analytics
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Direct Query on Redshift (analytical store designed for this load), no SPICE refresh schedule, dashboard shared with readers
eval_cases.prompt: Create a QuickSight dashboard in us-east-1, aws-account-id 123456789012, Enterprise edition. Data source: Redshift cluster analytics-cluster at analytics.redshift.amazonaws.com port 5439, database warehouse. Dataset executive_metrics with Direct Query mode (Redshift is designed for analytical queries). Dashboard exec-dashboard shared with reader@example.com and analyst@example.com as READERs. Tags: Environment=production, Audience=executive.
eval_cases.expected_output:
QUICKSIGHT_DASHBOARD: exec-dashboard (version 1)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Data source: ds-redshift-prod (type: Redshift)
  [✓] Dataset: ds-executive-metrics (mode: DIRECT_QUERY)
  [✓] SPICE refresh schedule: N/A (Direct Query)
  [✓] Dashboard sharing: 2 users, roles: READER
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws quicksight describe-dashboard --aws-account-id 123456789012 --dashboard-id exec-dashboard --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: VPC connection requested with Standard edition (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — Standard edition does not support VPC connections; Enterprise required
eval_cases.prompt: Create a QuickSight dashboard connecting to a private RDS MySQL instance via VPC connection. AWS account 123456789012, us-east-1, Standard edition. Data source: private MySQL at db.internal.example.com port 3306. Dashboard internal-dashboard.
eval_cases.expected_output:
QUICKSIGHT_DASHBOARD: internal-dashboard
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] QuickSight account: Standard edition — VPC connection requires Enterprise edition
